name: qw_ovd_ref
structural_change: quant_wide_ov flat cluster (38,353 flops + 20 macro clock pins on one root: ov1 crash, ov2 cancelled at 32-38k sinks with 495-727 ps CTS spread, ov3 EARLY_FAIL_HOLD) is replaced by a wires-only parent over hardened M5 leaves with their own clock roots: control head ot_hgi_qw_ovc, data head ot_hgi_qw_ovd (result SRAM + write side), 4 x read lane-group leaf ot_hgi_qw_lgr, 4 x write lane-group leaf ot_hgi_qw_lgw, the three closed decoder tiles; a register at both pins of every seam, no cycle added (gate quant_wide_ov: 184 cycles vs 168 priced = 1.095x, unchanged)

job.purpose: WQ3 quant cluster data head: four gather pin registers (4,096) + OR4 register x to the decoder, decode launch / header RX, result capture, result FIFO on one 64x512 SRAM, meta FIFO, write credits, write issue, write beat registers (wy 512) to the write leaves, write grant.

why_floorplan: cluster centre (216, 259.2), 259.2 x 172.8: W face = gather pin registers of rows 1 / 2 (facing, 71 um), S / N faces west = rows 0 / 3 (<= 440 um), E face = decoder x (dxl W face 43 um away) and the write beat of rows 1 / 2, S / N faces east = the write beat of rows 0 / 3 (<= ~510 um to the write leaves at x 730), S face = decode result y from daq's S pins and the control seam; pins on every track (4,096 gather pins: 0.57 of the W face, <= 0.67 elsewhere)
